heading: Jurisdiction of district courts
lead: The appropriate district court of the United States shall have and exercise jurisdiction of proceedings instituted under section 1706 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective on and after sixtieth day after Aug. 21, 1974, see section 2(c) of Pub. L. 93–380, set out as a note under section 1221–1 of this title.
